chat.say: Bhai tiffin me se thoda hissa de de na?
Poora dabba maang le, bachega kya mere liye!

data.asar: Dosti me utna hi maango jitna samne wala de sake.
data.caption:
UP me seat sharing par charcha tez ho chuki hai! 🗳️

• Congress ne SP se maangi 181 seats.
• Seat batware par abhi tak phansa hua hai pech.
• Gathbandhan ki meeting aur faisle par bana hua hai suspense.

Jab dost Maggi me se aadhi se zyada maang le, tab aisa hi scene banta hai. 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo hissa maangne me kabhi sharam nahi karta!
